entries.label: Another Gallery Podium
cells: Pardon my interruption sir, but I must urge you to buy this upgrade... another podium slot for your Gallery would be most becoming indeed!

entries.label: Brighter Lighthouse Bulb
cells: You can now find 3 additional Artifacts from The Edge island.

entries.label: Charmed, I'm Sure
cells: All your Ninja Twins can now equip two of the same charm at once!

entries.label: Chef Geustloaf's Cutting Edge Philosophy
cells: Increases the Max Level of all cooking meals by +10 again! But oh hoho, you sir are no Chef Geustloaf! Good luck cooking to these LVs!

entries.label: Coral Conservationism
cells: Boosts daily coral gain at the Coral Reef in World 7 in Shimmerfin Deep Town in the game IdleOn on the Left side of the map by +20%

entries.label: Crop Depot Scientist
cells: Employs a friendly scientist blobulyte to keep a Data Sheet of all the crops you've ever found!

entries.label: Deal Sweetening
cells: Earn +25% more Magic Beans from the mysterious Legumulyte bean merchant found in the Troll Broodnest map.

entries.label: Depth Charge Disposal
cells: All Minehead opponents in Mr. Minehead's Depth Charge game have 1 less Depth Charge to deploy! Less mines means less booms!

entries.label: Emperor Season Pass
cells: There is now a 50% chance to get +2 visits to the Emperor every day, and your maximum visits goes up from 6 to 11

entries.label: Essence Confetti
cells: Adds a new bonus of +3% All Essence Gain per 10 items found after 1000 items, as shown at The Slab in World 5.

entries.label: Gaming to the MAX
cells: All plant types in Gaming have +1 Max Evolution, but this one is 50,000x rarer than normal and will make you wonder if evolution is even real (it is)

entries.label: Gold Food Beanstalk
cells: Grows a giant beanstalk behind the ninja castle! Drop a stack of 10,000 Gold Food to add it with the beanstalk and permanently gain its bonus!

entries.label: Ionized Sigils
cells: Sigils can now be upgraded a 3rd time. Push past lame ol' yellow, and further increasing those sigil boosts!

entries.label: Jade Coin Magnetism
cells: Adds a new bonus of +5% Jade Coin Gain per 10 items found after 1000 items, as shown at The Slab in World 5.

entries.label: Laboratory Bling
cells: Adds 3 new Jewels to unlock at the Jewel Spinner in W4 Town. Or, get one for free every 700 total Lab LV as shown in Rift Skill Mastery.

entries.label: Level Exemption
cells: Completely and utterly removes the UNDER-LEVELED bonus reduction of all stamps in your collection, now and forever. Amen.

entries.label: Menagerie Maxxing
cells: You get +1 extra mission in the Luminous Menagerie, as well as a small but noble 1.10x hourly Lumi gains multiplier!

entries.label: Mob Cosplay Craze
cells: Certain monsters in World 6 will now have a rare chance to drop Ninja Hats, but only the ones you've found already from the Ninja Castle!

entries.label: MSA Expander I
cells: Adds a new bonus type to the Miniature Soul Apparatus in World 3, specifically Farming EXP!

entries.label: MSA Expander II
cells: Adds a new bonus type to the Miniature Soul Apparatus in World 3, specifically Jade Coin Gain!

entries.label: MSA Expander III
cells: Adds a new bonus type to the Miniature Soul Apparatus in World 3, specifically All Essence Gain!

entries.label: New Bribes
cells: Mr. Pigibank is up to no good once again, and he's looking to get some funding from his favorite patron... you. Well, your wallet specifically.

entries.label: New Critter
cells: Unlocks a new critter type to capture! These have their own very special vial in Alchemy.

entries.label: No Meal Left Behind
cells: Every 24 hours, your lowest level Meal gets +1 Lv. This only works on Meals Lv 2 or higher, and doesn't trigger on days you don't play.

entries.label: Optimal Optometry
cells: Your Optical Monocles give 1.35x more Insight EXP/hr, and your Kaleidoscopes have a 1.06x larger boost to adjacent magnifiers!

entries.label: Palette Slot
cells: Unlocks +1 Palette Slot in Gaming! This would be kinda pointless on it's own... so it comes with +100% Palette Luck!

entries.label: Papa Blob's Quality Guarantee
cells: Increases the Max Level of all cooking meals by +10. Better meals, better levels, Papa Blob's.

entries.label: Quick Ref Access
cells: Adds the Sneaking skill to your QuickRef menu! Manage your Ninja Twins from anywhere!

entries.label: Reinforced Science Pencil
cells: Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist's Data Sheet! Specifically '+20% Total Damage' per Crop!

entries.label: Revenge of the Pickle
cells: Adds a new boss page to the left of World 1 in Deathnote. Each BoneJoePickle in your inventory counts as +1 Boss Deathnote Kill!

entries.label: Science Chalk
cells: Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist! Specifically '+1% Research EXP' per 10 Crops after 200! So 240 crops would only give +4%

entries.label: Science Crayon
cells: Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist's Data Sheet! Specifically '+7% Shiny Mob Lv Up Rate and Mob Breeding Rate' per Crop!

entries.label: Science Environmentally Sourced Pencil
cells: Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist's Data Sheet! Specifically '+15% Cash from Mobs' per crop found!

entries.label: Science Fancy Pen
cells: Adds the 'Spelunky' bonus to your scientist, which boosts both POW and Amber gain by 5% per Crop after 200! So having 210 crops only gives +50%

entries.label: Science Featherpen
cells: Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist's Data Sheet! Specifically '1.10x Cooking Speed (multiplicative)' per Crop!

entries.label: Science Highlighter
cells: Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist! Specifically '+1% Drop Rate' per Crop after 100! So having 105 crops would only give +5%

entries.label: Science Marker
cells: Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist's Data Sheet! Specifically '+8% Jade Coin Gain' per Crop!

entries.label: Science Paintbrush
cells: Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist's Data Sheet! Specifically '+0.1 Base Critter caught in Trapping' per Crop!

entries.label: Science Pen
cells: Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist's Data Sheet! Specifically '1.02x Plant Evolution Chance in Gaming (multiplicative)' per Crop!

entries.label: Shrine Collective Bargaining Agreement
cells: Shrines no longer lose EXP when moved around, so you can finally bring those baddies out of retirement!

entries.label: Sovereign Artifacts
cells: You can now find Sovereign Artifacts from sailing, but only if you've found the Eldritch form first.

entries.label: Supersized Gold Beanstacking
cells: You can now drop a stack of 100,000 Gold Food to supersize it! This will obviously give a bigger bonus, and will even enlargen the food on the stalk!

entries.label: The Artifact Matrix
cells: Extends the Laboratory Event Horizon, adding another bonus to connect to! In particular, a boost to Artifact Find Chance!

entries.label: The Crop Matrix
cells: Yet again even further extends the Laboratory Event Horizon, adding another bonus to connect to! In particular, a boost to Crop Depot!

entries.label: The Endercaptain
cells: Adds the Endercaptain to Recruitment pool. They're very rare, and have a hidden account-wide +25% Loot Multi and Artifact Find.

entries.label: The Slab Matrix
cells: Further extends the Laboratory Event Horizon, adding another bonus to connect to! In particular, a boost to all bonuses from the Slab!

entries.label: The Spirit Matrix
cells: Even further extends the Laboratory Event Horizon, adding another bonus to connect to! In particular, a boost to W6 Skill exp gain!

entries.label: True Godly Blessings
cells: All Divinity Gods give 1.05x higher Blessing bonus per God Rank. Whats a Blessing bonus? Select a god, it's the one on the bottom, go look.

pageProps.seoDescription: Every one of the 48 jade emporium in Legends of Idleon, and what each one connects to.
